title: Llama dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='fur' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#f7e6c8'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#e8cfa5'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- legs dancing -->
  <rect x='34' y='62' width='7' height='24' rx='3' fill='#e8cfa5' transform='rotate(14 37 62)'/>
  <rect x='44' y='62' width='7' height='26' rx='3' fill='#f7e6c8' transform='rotate(-8 47 62)'/>
  <rect x='56' y='62' width='7' height='26' rx='3' fill='#e8cfa5' transform='rotate(10 59 62)'/>
  <rect x='65' y='62' width='7' height='22' rx='3' fill='#f7e6c8' transform='rotate(-16 68 62)'/>
  <!-- hooves -->
  <ellipse cx='33' cy='88' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#8a6b4a'/>
  <ellipse cx='49' cy='90' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#8a6b4a'/>
  <ellipse cx='61' cy='90' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#8a6b4a'/>
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='86' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#8a6b4a'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='51' cy='56' rx='22' ry='15' fill='url(#fur)'/>
  <!-- neck -->
  <path d='M62 52 Q70 36 66 26 L78 28 Q80 42 72 56 Z' fill='#f7e6c8'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='76' cy='24' rx='13' ry='10' fill='#f7e6c8'/>
  <!-- snout -->
  <ellipse cx='87' cy='27' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#f2d9ae'/>
  <circle cx='83' cy='22' r='1.8' fill='#5a3d26'/>
  <circle cx='79' cy='24' r='1.2' fill='#5a3d26'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <path d='M68 15 Q66 7 71 5 Q75 9 72 16 Z' fill='#e8cfa5'/>
  <path d='M76 14 Q76 6 81 6 Q84 11 80 16 Z' fill='#e8cfa5'/>
  <!-- raised arm waving -->
  <rect x='30' y='40' width='6' height='20' rx='3' fill='#f7e6c8' transform='rotate(40 33 50)'/>
  <circle cx='26' cy='36' r='4' fill='#e8cfa5'/>
  <!-- other arm -->
  <rect x='62' y='50' width='6' height='16' rx='3' fill='#e8cfa5' transform='rotate(-20 65 56)'/>
  <!-- fluffy tail -->
  <circle cx='29' cy='52' r='6' fill='#f7e6c8'/>
  <circle cx='26' cy='48' r='4' fill='#e8cfa5'/>
  <!-- motion sparkles -->
  <path d='M18 30 l2 5 5 2 -5 2 -2 5 -2 -5 -5 -2 5 -2 Z' fill='#ffd94a'/>
  <path d='M88 50 l2 4 4 2 -4 2 -2 4 -2 -4 -4 -2 4 -2 Z' fill='#ffd94a'/>
  <circle cx='15' cy='72' r='3' fill='#7fd0ff'/>
  <circle cx='90' cy='70' r='3' fill='#7fd0ff'/>
</svg>
